format_semantics: Document-format marker only. B005 does not create or register a runtime JSON Schema contract for this evidence artifact.

semantics.canonical_main_sha: The immutable GitHub main commit from which B005 canonical repository inputs were read. It is intentionally not the mutable feature-branch head.
semantics.feature_branch_head: Implementation/review evidence only. It must not replace canonical_main_sha because GitHub main is the project authority.
semantics.exact_head_equivalence_rule: At review/merge time, compare the current feature head to canonical_main_sha and verify that each canonical input path below still resolves to the declared blob SHA; any mismatch invalidates this binding and requires B005 re-evaluation.
